translations.web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
translations.bsb: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
translations.kjv: ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
translations.asv: ZAYIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.
